Run the three “Next Commands” in order; they’re already set up to (1) select the best AUB module candidate, (2) run system-level candidates, then (3) generate a “next fix” report. Here’s the exact sequence plus what to watch for.

## 1) AUB autopilot (module-level) + select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
**Expected outcome**
- Produces new module experiment results under your experiment outputs (and/or updates a “best” pointer depending on your tooling).
- If a candidate beats the current champion on the relevant metric(s), `--select-best` should promote it automatically.

**Quick sanity checks**
- Confirm it actually evaluated candidates (not a no-op due to empty registry filters).
- Confirm it recorded mean/min similar to the handoff stats you track.

## 2) System autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
**Expected outcome**
- Runs end-to-end system candidates defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.
- Should log comparisons vs the current champion (or at least produce comparable metrics).

**Quick sanity checks**
- Make sure `system_candidates.yaml` still points at the intended baseline/champion file and not an old pinned path.
- Verify any promoted module from step (1) is actually picked up by the system candidate definitions (some setups require explicit reference).

## 3) Generate next-fix report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Expected outcome**
- Writes `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` summarizing failures, weak spots, or highest-leverage next changes.

## If anything looks off, the two most common issues
1) **No candidates found / nothing ran**: registry/spec filters too restrictive or empty candidate lists.
2) **Metrics not comparable**: mismatch in evaluation suite/seed/config between runs; ensure the same benchmark set is used when comparing means/mins.

If you paste the stdout/stderr from any step (or the generated `next_fix.md`), I can help interpret results and decide whether to promote a new champion.
